note: There is no free, reliable API for county tax sales or auction platforms (Auction.com, Hubzu, etc.). This file has two parts: 'resources' are verified links to check yourself, and 'listings' is where you manually add specific properties you find so they show up on the map/list alongside the RentCast for-sale data. Edit this file directly to add listings.
